# Copilot instructions

The canonical, vendor-neutral agent instructions for RAHN are [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read it before suggesting changes.

It covers the repository map, the mandatory reading order, the non-negotiable rules (determinism, explicit transitions, no AI in the core, simulation-first execution), the build/test/lint commands, what must never be changed, and how to report evidence. Project policy for agent-assisted contributions is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
